summary.text: Rip Sullivan is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 6th District since September 12, 2014.
The district covers part of Fairfax County.
The House profile lists Majority Caucus Chair (2020-2022) and Minority Caucus Campaign Chair (2016-2019) as Rip Sullivan's leadership roles.

paragraphs.text: Rip Sullivan was born in New York, NY.
The profile lists an Amherst College B.A. (magna cum laude, 1981) and a University of Virginia School of Law J.D. (1987).
Rip Sullivan's listed occupation is attorney.
The profile lists membership in the Virginia State Bar, the District of Columbia Bar, the U.S. Supreme Court Bar and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 4th Circuit Bar.
Rip Sullivan serves on the Labor and Commerce Committee (as vice chair), Finance, Courts of Justice and Rules.

sources.title: Richard C. (Rip) Sullivan, Jr., Virginia House of Delegates, 6th District
